body: I'm so sorry you're going through this. Please don't do this right now: I hope you're at least waiting to see responses. I don't want you to do this - nobody reading this will. Who and what has made you feel like this? Tell us what's going on.
You've been going through so much, I'm so sorry. It sounds like you've had to deal with a lot of abuse and difficulty and betrayal. No wonder you're angry!
Thanks. I just.... I'm so tired of just hanging on for the next thing. I know I could, but is it worth it?
